text: At sunrise Pip was sent out with one job. Find where that light comes out.
He circled the north cliff eleven times, mostly to be admired.
On the twelfth, he saw it. A slit in the rock just above the waterline, black, the width of a door.
From out at sea, a light in there would sit low and steady. Right below the lighthouse.
Gus went very quiet. Every keeper knows what two lights, one above the other, mean to a sailor.
They mean: line us up, and you are safe.
